review_basis: AH-1050 / NXT09 review from 1feacd3d133b5c6a0de8254439ef6bac5f78275c to checkout 4580b7d6d692013091d5c66e90d703d51fd5fb10 and exact uncommitted source hashes below. The service-local generic extraction preserves the old domain; a second, bounded immutable-byte domain shares across standard Node SDK runtimes using an independently scoped read-only transport. SharedProducer now models both domains, capacity admission, creator cancellation and slow-finalizer occupancy. RequestAdmission code and semantic model are unchanged.

SharedProducer.bounds: Two concurrent waiters, one shared or two separate producers, one replacement; transport and immutable domains; five contexts; immutable registry limit 1 or 2 with unit-weight producers. This bounds admitted unfinished shared producers, including slow finalizers, not all independent fallback requests. Equality abstracts the complete credential/origin/version/physical Store/fixed owner+snapshot+content/read-only/policy/timeout/scheduler identity.
SharedProducer.scope: Transport coalescers remain service local. Only exact immutable network bytes in one Node process may cross standard SDK runtime boundaries. Each caller independently qualifies its original pin/current owner and persists to its own Store; the producer owns its own read-only transport Scope and no Store. Custom transports and opt-in RequestBudget bypass cross-runtime sharing. No cross-process content sharing. Effect dependency scope is reference counting and entry-identity removal only.

RequestAdmission.bounds: One invocation with opt-in budget, two admitted attempts, four clock ticks, short/long queue window, one-tick attempt timer; read and mutating request variants.
RequestAdmission.scope: Shared SQL claims are abstract atomic decisions. No proof of SQLite driver/crash, arbitrary clocks, all rate-limit scopes, byte serialization, or cross-machine coordination.

effect.scope: Only the pending Cache reference-counting and current-entry cleanup guards called by makeSharedResultCoalescer and the service-local wrapper; not whole-library verification.

test_signature_review.change: Factory return inference requires the fifth withAdmission options argument; explicitly pass an empty options object in the cooled-queue test. Runtime defaults and tested contract are unchanged. Typecheck and the affected four real tests are rerun.

maintenance.routing: Relevant protected-source, model, config, view, coverage, runner and skill changes run this suite in formal CI. Use --model for a reviewed local slice.

maintenance.model_semantics: Review every declared rule, finite bound and environment/fairness assumption; keep exact expected negatives.
maintenance.implementation_semantics: Trace named functions and callers before updating hashes; run corresponding real-code regressions and guard mutations. Hash-only refresh cannot satisfy this review.
maintenance.rule_inventory: cases.expected_rules is a reviewed independent inventory. Do not regenerate it automatically from modified cfg files.

nxt_semantic_review.limitations: Unit-weight registry limit 1/2 is an abstraction of entry and declared-byte bounds; weighted byte arithmetic is tested in the actual implementation. The model tracks the first producer in detail; the independent second producer terminates only for isolation observation. It does not prove fairness, arbitrary waiters/generations, real HTTP byte totals, all authorization boundaries, or local object persistence.

unmodeled_bindings.name: external_first_policy_same_version_alignment_and_exact_git_transfer
unmodeled_bindings.scope: External-first auto policy blocks unsupported/transformed implicit full-byte retention; explicit retained source/caller decisions and old frozen plans retain their semantics. Standard Node CLI/SDK can retrieve exact pinned commit/tree/path/OID/hash/mode through optional machine Git or existing raw HTTP, sharing original content-addressed cache ownership. No checkout or resource execution, no wrong-hash fallback, unknown Git wire bytes stay unknown. Existing-library alignment wraps the original source-refresh v4 metadata selection and ACK journal after same-original-revision/all-file identity and governance proof; it preserves original pages, custom/tombstone/eligibility/relations/history, adds no binary objects, and unknown selection is not replayed from current equality. Disabled authoring is exact-target only. Concrete Git transport, storage-choice policy and the new proof wrapper are outside unchanged finite TLA domains; dedicated real Git, cold cache, original unknown/custom tests, independent installed CLI/SDK and actual-library evidence remain separate. Existing retained fixtures make their prior storage choice explicit, without dropping negative guards. All model/config/expected_rules inventories remain unchanged. See docs/maintenance-verification-review.md SRC08.

unmodeled_bindings.name: machine_github_api_and_readonly_gh_authentication
unmodeled_bindings.scope: Machine-local GitHub API prefixes route commit/tree and exact blobs without changing shared source IDs. Official environment credentials or an existing gh github.com session are isolated from custom APIs; only explicit dedicated credentials may reach a custom gateway. The standard optional gh service is lazy/memoized per operation, bounded/noninteractive, captures the complete SDK ConfigProvider child environment, never logs/stores tokens, and performs no login/refresh/setup-git. Custom JSON/base64 blobs are size/OID/hash validated; redirects, returned URLs, auth failures and rate limits do not authorize credential rotation or alternate-host fallback. In-flight immutable byte coalescing is additionally scoped to ConfigProvider and gh service; verified content-addressed cache ownership and existing permissions remain unchanged. Real isolated gh, safe failure/large payload/cache/concurrency tests, independent installed CLI/SDK and separate actual Broker/official-gh evidence cover the added behavior. Initial actual Broker 502 remains a failed original; a later independent cold success is separate evidence. These transport/auth procedures and external network behavior are NOT enumerated in unchanged finite TLA domains. Original model/config/cases/expected_rules are unchanged; hash correspondence is not a new theorem. See docs/maintenance-verification-review.md SRC09.

post_source_api_ci_review.scope: Retained loopback/registry journeys make the existing explicit storage choice; the storage HTTP fixture builds its default executable on clean checkouts and preserves explicit installed executables.
